title: Jam sessions on Central Avenue
summary: Moore describes houses turned into joints, jamming with Art Tatum, and how lively Los Angeles was.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: Were there any jam sessions in Los Angeles that you'd go to -- down in Watts, say on Central Avenue?

Oh, yes! I mean, oh --every, every house seems to be a huge joint, you know. The joints sprung up. And at that time I remember playing with Art Tat m. At the jam session I get my horn out, and I hear -- every time I see Art I used to get my horn out and play. And, those sessions were all, all around. And a -- oh, Los Angeles was jumping during that, during that era.
Really, really big fun out there at that time.
